assumptions: Sensitivity is REBASE's per-methylase table, localised by whether the methylase's motif overlaps the site's marked base.
The host carries the methylases named.
limits: Says whether a site is blocked, not how much activity survives a partial block.
bio.jane/contract.question: Does the host's methylation block these enzymes at each of their sites on this molecule?

description: Whether the host's own methylation blocks the given enzymes ON THIS PLASMID, from REBASE's methylation-sensitivity tables localised onto your sites. The other term of the same reaction question `find_star_sites` answers. It is deliberately per-SITE and not per-enzyme: REBASE says Dam blocks ClaI, and pBR322's single ClaI site carries no overlapping GATC, so the enzyme-level warning does not apply there. An enzyme REBASE has never examined comes back `examined: false`, which is UNTESTED and never a clearance.

_files.description: The project: record references shaped like _subject. Their records become library documents a tool names in sequences/parts/document; a trace or alignment is found by file name.

_subject.description: The record to act on: exactly one of sequence, accession (+source), sample (an id from list_samples) or file ({name, text} or {name, base64}); record_index picks one record of several.

enzymes.description: enzymes to check — resolved against the bundled cut catalog (REBASE spellings; smaller than the REBASE dossier the editor shows). Left unset, the run uses your active enzyme collection.

name: check_methylation_block

blocked.description: how many of the enzymes are blocked or impaired at at least one site HERE — branch on this rather than on the presence of a verdict, because a `cut` verdict is also a verdict

blockedEnzymes.description: the names of those enzymes, for a message that says which one to swap

enzymes.description: per enzyme: its REBASE recognition site, how many sites this molecule carries, whether REBASE has examined it, and one verdict row per methylase localised onto those sites

unexamined.description: how many of the enzymes REBASE has NOT tested against any methylase
